note: Visit, admission, screening and referral lookups over the semantic layer (visit = one row per encounter, latest version; stay = collapsed hospital stays; social_need = screening answers across instruments).

rules.description: Patients with at least N visits of a type in a period

which.select: SELECT patient_id FROM pop WHERE patient_id IN (SELECT patient_id FROM freq) ORDER BY 1

count.select: SELECT count(*) FROM pop WHERE patient_id IN (SELECT patient_id FROM freq)

plan.query: WITH pop AS (SELECT patient_id FROM patient WHERE {population.where}), freq AS (SELECT patient_id FROM visit WHERE {encounter.pred} AND {period.where:event_date} GROUP BY patient_id HAVING count(DISTINCT encounter_id) >= {n.value}) {variant.select}

positives.question: Which members had 3 or more ED visits in the last 6 months?
How many patients with heart failure had 2 or more admissions in 2028?

negatives: Which members had 3 or more ED visits in the last 6 months by practice?
Which members will have 3 or more ED visits next quarter?

rules.description: Facilities ranked by the number of visits/admissions of our members

plan.query: SELECT v.organization_id AS facility, o.display_name AS facility_name, count(DISTINCT v.encounter_id) AS visits, count(DISTINCT v.patient_id) AS patients FROM visit v LEFT JOIN organization o ON o.organization_id = v.organization_id WHERE {encounter.pred} AND {period.where:v.event_date} AND v.patient_id IN (SELECT patient_id FROM patient WHERE {population.where}) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY visits DESC

positives.question: Which hospitals account for the most admissions of our attributed members?
Which facilities account for the most ED visits in 2029?

negatives: Which hospitals account for the most admissions and why?
Which hospitals account for the most leakage?

rules.description: Visits of a type per 1,000 attributed patients for each practice or PCP

plan.query: WITH pop AS (SELECT patient_id, {unit.col} AS unit FROM patient WHERE {population.where}), n AS (SELECT p.unit, count(DISTINCT v.encounter_id) AS visits FROM visit v JOIN pop p ON p.patient_id = v.patient_id WHERE {encounter.pred} AND {period.where:v.event_date} GROUP BY 1) SELECT pop.unit AS {unit.value}, count(*) AS members, coalesce(n.visits, 0) AS visits, round(1000.0 * coalesce(n.visits, 0) / count(*), 1) AS per_1000 FROM pop LEFT JOIN n ON n.unit = pop.unit GROUP BY pop.unit ORDER BY per_1000 DESC
plan.purpose: {encounter.value} per 1,000 {population.text} by assigned {unit.value} (members = patients assigned to the unit; {period.start}..{period.end})

positives.question: How many annual wellness visits per 1,000 attributed members did each practice complete this year?
Urgent care visits per 1,000 patients by PCP in 2028

negatives: How many annual wellness visits per 1,000 attributed members did each practice complete this year compared with benchmark?
ED visits per 1,000 by practice adjusted for case mix

rules.description: Share of each PCP's or practice's assigned patients with a visit of a type in the period, ranked

plan.query: WITH pop AS (SELECT patient_id, {unit.col} AS unit FROM patient WHERE {unit.col} IS NOT NULL), done AS (SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM visit v WHERE {encounter.pred} AND {period.where:v.event_date}) SELECT unit AS {unit.value}, count(*) AS patients, sum(patient_id IN (SELECT patient_id FROM done)) AS completed, round(100.0 * sum(patient_id IN (SELECT patient_id FROM done)) / count(*), 2) AS completion_pct FROM pop GROUP BY unit ORDER BY completion_pct {direction.order}, patients DESC
plan.purpose: Share of each assigned {unit.value}'s patients with a {encounter.value} in {period.start}..{period.end}, {direction.value} first

positives.question: Which providers have the lowest AWV completion rate among their attributed patients?
Which practices have the highest wellness visit rates among their patients in 2028?

negatives: Which providers have the lowest AWV completion rate among their attributed patients after adjusting for case mix?
Which providers have the lowest TCM visit completion rate after discharge?

rules.description: Patients ranked by the number of distinct specialists seen
rules.pattern: ^which {population} (?:have|had) the (?:highest|largest|most) number of (?:distinct |different )?specialists(?: seen)? {period?}$|^which {population} (?:have )?(?:seen|saw) the most (?:distinct |different )?specialists {period?}$

plan.query: SELECT v.patient_id, count(DISTINCT v.attending_clinician_id) AS distinct_specialists, count(DISTINCT v.encounter_id) AS specialist_visits FROM visit v WHERE v.type_concept = 'specialist_visit' AND v.attending_clinician_id IS NOT NULL AND {period.where:v.event_date} AND v.patient_id IN (SELECT patient_id FROM patient WHERE {population.where}) GROUP BY v.patient_id ORDER BY distinct_specialists DESC, specialist_visits DESC, v.patient_id LIMIT 50
plan.purpose: Top 50 {population.text} by distinct attending clinicians on specialist visits ({period.start}..{period.end})

positives.question: Which members have the highest number of distinct specialists seen this year?

negatives: Which members have the highest number of distinct specialists seen this year and why?
Which specialists see the most members?

rules.description: Share of one visit type made by patients who never had another visit type
rules.pattern: ^what (?:percent|share|proportion|%) of {first} (?:by (?:our )?(?:members|patients) )?(?:are|were|come from|came from) (?:by |from )?(?:members|patients) who (?:never had|have never had|had no|have not had) (?:an? |any )?{second} {period?}$

plan.query: WITH f AS (SELECT encounter_id, patient_id FROM visit WHERE {first.pred} AND {period.where:event_date}), seen AS (SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM visit WHERE {second.pred} AND (event_date IS NULL OR event_date <= '{period.end}')) SELECT round(100.0 * sum(patient_id NOT IN (SELECT patient_id FROM seen)) / nullif(count(*), 0), 2) FROM f
plan.purpose: Percent of {first.value} ({period.start}..{period.end}) made by patients with no {second.value} on record up to {period.end}

positives.question: What percent of ED visits by our members are by members who never had a PCP visit?

negatives: What percent of ED visits by our members are by members who never had a PCP visit, by practice?
What percent of ED visits are avoidable?

rules.description: Share of ED visits ending in an inpatient admission, by month/quarter/year
rules.pattern: ^what (?:percent|share|proportion|%) of (?:ed|er|emergency(?: department| room)?) visits (?:end in|ended in|result in|resulted in|lead to|led to|are admitted|were admitted)(?: an?)?(?: inpatient)?(?: admissions?)?(?: \(admit rate\))? (?:by|per) {grain}{period?}(?:,? and (?:is|has) it (?:been )?(?:rising|falling|increasing|decreasing|going up|going down|changing))?$

plan.query: SELECT {grain.expr} AS {grain.value}, count(*) AS ed_visits, sum(disposition IN ('admitted', 'inpatient_admission')) AS admitted, sum(disposition IS NULL) AS disposition_not_recorded, round(100.0 * sum(disposition IN ('admitted', 'inpatient_admission')) / nullif(sum(disposition IS NOT NULL), 0), 2) AS admit_pct FROM visit WHERE type_concept = 'emergency_visit' AND event_date IS NOT NULL AND {period.where:event_date} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
plan.purpose: ED admit rate by {grain.value} = ED visits with an admitted disposition / ED visits with a recorded disposition (visits without a disposition counted separately)

positives.question: What percent of ED visits end in an admission (admit rate) by month, and is it rising?
What share of ER visits resulted in an inpatient admission by quarter?

negatives: What percent of ED visits end in an admission by practice?
Why is the share of ED visits ending in admission rising?

rules.description: Share of a population screened for social needs (any instrument) in a period

plan.query: WITH pop AS (SELECT patient_id FROM patient WHERE {population.where}), screened AS (SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM social_need WHERE need IN {need.in} AND {period.where:event_date}) SELECT round(100.0 * (SELECT count(*) FROM pop WHERE patient_id IN (SELECT patient_id FROM screened)) / nullif((SELECT count(*) FROM pop), 0), 2)
plan.purpose: Percent of {population.text} with a {need.value} screen answer on any instrument in {period.start}..{period.end}

positives.question: What percent of attributed patients have been screened for health-related social needs this year?
What share of adults 65 and older were screened for food insecurity in 2028?

negatives: What percent of attributed patients screened positive for social needs this year?
What percent of patients have been screened for depression this year?

rules.description: Practices or PCPs ranked by how many of their assigned patients were screened for social needs

plan.query: WITH screened AS (SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM social_need WHERE need IN {need.in} AND {period.where:event_date}) SELECT {unit.col} AS {unit.value}, count(*) AS patients, sum(patient_id IN (SELECT patient_id FROM screened)) AS screened_patients, round(100.0 * sum(patient_id IN (SELECT patient_id FROM screened)) / count(*), 2) AS screened_pct FROM patient WHERE {unit.col} IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY screened_patients {direction.order}, screened_pct {direction.order}
plan.purpose: Assigned patients screened for {need.value} by {unit.value}, {direction.value} first ({period.start}..{period.end})

positives.question: Which practices screen the fewest patients for social needs?

negatives: Which practices screen the fewest patients for depression?
Which practices screen the fewest patients for social needs relative to need?

rules.description: Patients in a population with no referral to a specialty on record

which.select: SELECT patient_id FROM pop WHERE patient_id NOT IN (SELECT patient_id FROM referred) ORDER BY 1

count.select: SELECT count(*) FROM pop WHERE patient_id NOT IN (SELECT patient_id FROM referred)

plan.query: WITH pop AS (SELECT patient_id FROM patient WHERE {population.where}), referred AS (SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM record WHERE stream = 'referrals' AND (json_extract(payload, '$.requested_specialty') = '{specialty.value}' OR json_extract(payload, '$.specialty') = '{specialty.value}') AND {period.where:event_date}) {variant.select}
plan.purpose: {population.text} with no referral record naming {specialty.value} (requested or receiving specialty) in {period.start}..{period.end}
